newsitem.title: USA: Sun names former Ultramar COO as Sun's COO.
newsitem.headline: Sun names former Ultramar COO as Sun's COO.

text.p: Sun Co said Wednesday that it has named John Drosdick, formerly the president and chief operating officer of Ultramar Corp, to be president and chief operating officer at Sun.
Drosdick, who is also a former president and chief executive of Tosco Corp, will also be elected a Sun Co director at Sun's December board meeting, the company said.

Sun's chief executive and chairman, Robert Campbell, has served as the company's president and chief operating officer since 1991. He will remain chief executive and chairman after Drosdick joins, Sun said.
Drosdick left Ultramar in August. His appointment at Sun is effective immediately, and he will have responsibility for all of Sun's seven operating units, Sun said.

Ultramar Corp announced a "merger of equals" with Diamond Shamrock in September. On Monday, Tosco announced it had signed a letter of intent to buy all operating assets of Unocal's West Coast refining and marketing business.
